name: skillos
description: Local-first skill orchestration for coding agents. Discover installed skills, recommend staged skill chains, expose MCP tools, generate client presets, and record explainable decisions.

interface.shortDescription: Route tasks to local skills and tools
interface.longDescription: SkillOS is a local-first orchestration layer that inventories local skills and tools, recommends staged skill chains, exposes MCP tools, records routing decisions, accepts feedback, and generates client presets for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, OpenHands, OpenClaw, and OpenClaw-like runtimes.
defaultPrompt: Use SkillOS to choose the right skills for this task.
Run SkillOS doctor and recommend a skill chain.
Configure SkillOS presets for my agent clients.
